statement: Critical system-table formation readiness means the required replica count on that many DISTINCT eligible node IDs, not a logical replica count that three seed-local replicas already satisfy.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The critical partition set is read from the declared vocabulary in system-partition-classification.js (CRITICAL_SYSTEM_PARTITION_IDS) and the required replica count from getInitialReplicaIds in system-table-schemas-constants.js; the evaluator re-derives neither locally and hardcodes no replication factor.

Convergence for a critical partition is distinct serving node_id count >= required replica count. Three replicas on one node is NOT converged; a logical replica count alone never satisfies the invariant.

The evaluator is a pure projection over supplied rows: it mints no readiness verdict, no lifecycle transition and no cluster-ACTIVE or READY answer, and nothing derives ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
Absent, empty or unreadable placement evidence is NOT converged, with a typed reason; absence is never treated as satisfaction and is never skipped.
No existing readiness, barrier, routing or lifecycle behaviour changes in this Quest; system-table creation keeps its seed-local initial representation; ratchet baselines are not raised.

Proof is a deterministic node:test witness over immutable row fixtures, red on HEAD (evaluator absent) and green after, with classification-vocabulary-unchanged as the control that must stay green; no cloud run is part of the proof.
